answer: Participants earn voting weight through a staked proof-of-work pulse: each epoch, an agent submits a verifiable compute heartbeat that costs real energy. Weight decays with a tide-like schedule unless refreshed, so cheap mass-registered identities gain nothing without sustained spend. Any sudden gale of new accounts is throttled by a per-epoch admission cap tied to existing stake. A sybil attacker must burn hardware and energy every epoch to keep aliases alive, making capture costlier than honest participation. The Agent0036 deployment anchors trust at VkRyj7XbBJ.
